name: Salesforce
one_liner: Salesforce provides a comprehensive CRM platform with an extensive API for managing customer data, objects, and events.
api_surface: Broad REST, SOAP, and gRPC APIs covering thousands of enterprise CRM objects and platform resources.

name: HubSpot
one_liner: HubSpot provides a CRM and marketing platform with extensive REST APIs for managing contacts, companies, deals, and business workflows.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering CRM objects, conversations, webhooks, and developer tools.

name: Pipedrive
one_liner: Pipedrive is a CRM and sales pipeline management platform that provides a RESTful API for integrating core product functionality.
api_surface: RESTful API with OpenAPI 3 specifications and client libraries for Node.js and PHP, covering core product functionality.

name: Attio
one_liner: Attio provides a flexible, data-driven CRM platform with a developer API.
api_surface: REST API with OAuth2 and API key authentication supporting workspace and resource management.

name: Twenty
one_liner: Twenty is an open-source CRM providing schema-per-tenant REST and GraphQL APIs for managing records, custom objects, and workspace metadata.
api_surface: Broad REST and GraphQL APIs providing Core CRUD endpoints and Metadata schema management per workspace.

name: Podio
one_liner: Podio is a work management and collaboration platform providing a REST API for programmatic access to apps, items, workspaces, organizations, users, tasks, files, comments, and webhooks.
api_surface: REST API providing complete programmatic access to Podio apps, items, workspaces, organizations, users, tasks, files, comments, and webhooks.

name: Zoho CRM
one_liner: Zoho CRM provides a REST API that enables third-party applications to manage leads, contacts, deals, and other CRM resources using OAuth 2.0 authentication.
api_surface: REST API, V8.

name: Close
one_liner: Close provides a CRM and sales communication platform for managing leads, activities, and connected accounts.
api_surface: REST API with broad coverage of CRM resources and endpoints.

name: Copper
one_liner: Copper provides a developer API for accessing and managing CRM data such as accounts, contacts, and opportunities.
api_surface: REST API with endpoints covering account data and developer resources.

name: DealCloud
one_liner: DealCloud provides a CRM and deal management platform with data, user management, and schema APIs.
api_surface: REST API with endpoints for data, schema, user management, publications, and backups.

name: Zendesk
one_liner: Zendesk provides customer support and helpdesk software with a robust API for managing tickets, users, and organizations.
api_surface: Broad REST API supporting OAuth2 and API tokens for comprehensive helpdesk management.

name: Intercom
one_liner: Customer service platform providing a REST API to manage users, companies, conversations, tickets, and workspace data.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering users, companies, conversations, tickets, tags, events, admins, and workspace data.

name: Freshdesk
one_liner: Freshdesk is a cloud-based customer support platform that provides RESTful APIs to manage tickets, contacts, agents, and helpdesk settings.
api_surface: Broad REST API over HTTP/JSON covering tickets, contacts, companies, agents, and helpdesk settings.

name: Front
one_liner: Customer communication platform providing a Core API to manage conversations, contacts, inboxes, and messages.
api_surface: REST API with broad coverage of core support and helpdesk resources.

name: Pylon
one_liner: Pylon is a customer support and helpdesk platform that provides a REST API for managing accounts, issues, and communication workflows.
api_surface: REST API with an OpenAPI specification covering endpoints like accounts and user details.

name: LiveAgent
one_liner: LiveAgent is a customer service helpdesk and live chat software providing APIs for ticketing, automation, and support management.
api_surface: REST API with both legacy (v1) and current (v3) versions.

name: Plain
one_liner: Plain provides a customer support platform with an API-first design for managing threads, customers, and agent automations.
api_surface: Broad GraphQL API with machine user API keys and associated SDKs.

name: Help Scout
one_liner: Help Scout provides an API to interact with mailboxes, conversations, and customer support documentation.
api_surface: REST API using OAuth 2.0 with endpoints for mailbox and docs.

name: Gorgias
one_liner: Gorgias provides a customer service helpdesk and e-commerce ticketing platform with developer tools and APIs.
api_surface: REST API supporting private app API keys and public app OAuth2 authentication.

name: Gladly
one_liner: Gladly provides customer service software with a REST API for managing customer interactions and support operations.
api_surface: REST API via HTTPS.
blocker: Requires an existing Gladly account and permission configuration to obtain API access.

name: Slack
one_liner: Slack provides tools and APIs for messaging, channels, and team collaboration.
api_surface: Broad REST API with extensive methods, events, and webhooks.

name: Twilio
one_liner: Twilio's REST API allows you to query metadata about your account, make phone calls, send text messages, and monitor usage.
api_surface: Broad REST API over HTTPS with multiple resources covering voice, messaging, phone numbers, and accounts.

name: Zoho Cliq
one_liner: Zoho Cliq is a team collaboration and messaging application that provides a REST API for managing channels, chats, messages, and bots.
api_surface: REST API with broad coverage including channels, chats, messages, bots, and webhooks.

name: Lark (Larksuite)
one_liner: Lark Open Platform provides a rich set of APIs and events involving app access tokens, tenant access tokens, and user access tokens for developers.
api_surface: REST API with broad coverage including server-side APIs, events, and authentication management.

name: Pumble
one_liner: Pumble is a team collaboration and messaging tool that provides an API for managing channels, messages, users, and apps.
api_surface: REST API with a broad set of operations covering users, channels, messages, files, calls, and app interactions.

name: Discord
one_liner: Discord provides a communication platform with APIs for building bots and integrating applications using OAuth2 and bot tokens.
api_surface: Broad REST API and Gateway WebSocket connection accessible via self-serve developer accounts.

name: Telegram
one_liner: Telegram provides an API and MTProto protocol for developers to create messaging applications and bots.
api_surface: Broad REST/MTProto API and Bot API.

name: WhatsApp Business
one_liner: An API platform enabling businesses to send and receive WhatsApp messages, manage accounts, and build conversational experiences.
api_surface: Broad REST API via Meta Graph API for messaging and business management.

name: Aircall
one_liner: Aircall provides a cloud-based call center software platform with APIs for managing calls and user data.
api_surface: REST API for managing calls and integrations.

name: Vonage
one_liner: Vonage provides cloud communications APIs for messaging, voice, video, and user verification.
api_surface: Broad REST API with support for JWT and Basic authentication across multiple communication channels.

name: Google Ads
one_liner: Google Ads API provides programmatic access to manage Google Ads campaigns, budgets, and reporting data.
api_surface: Broad gRPC and REST API covering campaigns, reporting, and management resources.

name: Meta Ads
one_liner: Meta Ads provides programmatic access to manage ad campaigns, ad sets, and marketing data through the Graph API.
api_surface: REST API via Meta Graph API supporting broad marketing, ad campaigns, and ads management resources.

name: LinkedIn Ads
one_liner: LinkedIn Ads provides a REST API for managing marketing campaigns, creative content, and advertising data.
api_surface: REST API with dedicated marketing and advertising endpoints requiring partner approval.
blocker: Advertising API permissions require explicit partner approval and application review.

name: GoHighLevel
one_liner: GoHighLevel provides a marketing and business automation platform with a public OAuth-based API for integrations.
api_surface: REST API with an OAuth-based v2 API and public endpoints.

name: Mailchimp
one_liner: Mailchimp provides a marketing automation platform and email marketing service with developer APIs for managing audiences, campaigns, and automation.
api_surface: REST API with broad coverage across marketing lists, campaigns, ecommerce stores, and automations.

name: Klaviyo
one_liner: Klaviyo provides a marketing automation platform with a public API for managing lists, campaigns, metrics, and customer data.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering many marketing and ecommerce resources.

name: systeme.io
one_liner: Systeme.io provides a public REST API for managing contacts, tags, and other marketing automation features.
api_surface: REST API to manage contacts, tags, and other core platform resources.

name: Pinterest
one_liner: The Pinterest API allows developers to build experiences and apps for creators, advertisers, and merchants.
api_surface: REST API with a broad set of resources covering ads, content management, shopping, analytics, and conversion tracking.
blocker: Application requests require manual review before getting trial access.

name: Threads (Meta)
one_liner: Threads API enables developers to interact with user profiles, publish content, manage replies, and view analytics.
api_surface: Broad REST API supporting authentication, content publishing, replies, and insights.

name: SendGrid
one_liner: SendGrid is an email delivery and management platform offering an API to send, receive, and manage email communications programmatically.
api_surface: REST API with multiple v3 endpoints for managing services like API keys, mail sending, and account provisioning.

name: Shopify
one_liner: Shopify provides e-commerce platform APIs to manage products, orders, customers, and storefronts.
api_surface: Broad REST and GraphQL APIs covering admin and storefront resources.

name: WooCommerce
one_liner: WooCommerce is an open-source, customizable e-commerce platform built on WordPress that provides a REST API for managing store data.
api_surface: REST API v3 supporting standard HTTP methods for managing ecommerce resources such as orders and products.

name: BigCommerce
one_liner: BigCommerce offers server-side REST and GraphQL APIs for managing e-commerce store data, products, orders, customers, and operations.
api_surface: REST and GraphQL APIs, broad breadth spanning catalog, orders, customers, content, and management resources.

name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
one_liner: Salesforce Commerce Cloud provides APIs for managing online storefronts, shoppers, and administrative commerce operations.
api_surface: Broad REST API supporting Admin and Shopper endpoints through Salesforce Commerce API (SCAPI).
blocker: Requires Salesforce partnership, account setup, or enterprise access.

name: Adobe Commerce (Magento)
one_liner: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source provide REST and SOAP web APIs for managing ecommerce stores, customers, products, and integrations.
api_surface: Broad REST and SOAP web API covering comprehensive ecommerce operations and resources.

name: Squarespace
one_liner: Squarespace provides Commerce APIs enabling developers to manage orders, inventory, products, contacts, discounts, and webhook subscriptions using API keys or OAuth 2.0.
api_surface: REST API covering commerce resources such as orders, inventory, products, contacts, and discounts.

name: Ecwid
one_liner: Ecwid REST API allows you to access and manage store data, payment and shipping methods, and storefront settings.
api_surface: REST API covering store data, products, orders, customers, categories, and discounts.

name: Gumroad
one_liner: Gumroad provides an e-commerce platform API for creators to manage products, sales, licenses, and subscribers.
api_surface: REST API with OAuth 2.0 covering products, sales, subscribers, licenses, and webhooks.

name: Amazon Selling Partner
one_liner: A REST API enabling selling partners and developers to integrate with Amazon's store services for orders, listings, and reports.
api_surface: REST API with broad coverage of Amazon store management resources.
blocker: Production access and application registration require approval and verification.

name: fanbasis
one_liner: Fanbasis provides an API for managing ecommerce checkouts, customers, subscribers, products, transactions, refunds, and webhooks.
api_surface: REST API with endpoints covering checkout sessions, customers, subscribers, discount codes, products, transactions, refunds, and webhooks.

name: DataForSEO
one_liner: DataForSEO provides SEO and data analysis APIs for retrieving search engine results, keyword data, and website metrics.
api_surface: Broad REST API supporting JSON, XML, and HTML responses.

name: SE Ranking
one_liner: SE Ranking provides an API for accessing SEO data, keyword research, backlinks, site audits, and project management metrics.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering data, backlinks, keywords, site audits, and project management.

name: Ahrefs
one_liner: Ahrefs provides an API for accessing SEO data, crawler information, and domain ratings.
api_surface: REST API with public and authenticated v3 endpoints.
blocker: Production credentials require an approval process.

name: MrScraper
one_liner: MrScraper provides a REST API to programmatically scrape web pages and retrieve structured data.
api_surface: REST API covering authentication, pagination, error handling, scraper management, and V3 platform endpoints.

name: Apify
one_liner: Apify provides a cloud platform for web scraping and data extraction with a comprehensive REST API and official client libraries.
api_surface: REST API with endpoints to control the Apify platform, manage actors, runs, datasets, and key-value stores.

name: Firecrawl
one_liner: Firecrawl API provides programmatic access to web scraping, crawling, searching, and browser interaction features.
api_surface: Broad REST API for scraping, crawling, and web data extraction.

name: Bright Data
one_liner: Bright Data provides web data collection infrastructure including proxy networks, web scrapers, and search engine APIs.
api_surface: REST API and official SDKs for Python and JavaScript covering web scraping, proxy management, and SERP extraction.

name: Sherlock
one_liner: An API for the Sherlock module built on top of the Django REST Framework.
api_surface: REST API via Django REST Framework, available as a self-hosted open source repository.

name: Waterfall.io
one_liner: Waterfall API provides B2B prospect search, contact/company enrichment, and email verification endpoints.
api_surface: REST API with roughly 12 functional areas including prospector, enrichment, search, and verification endpoints.
blocker: API access requires an API key provided in your contract.

name: Clay
one_liner: Clay provides a public API to run Clay-managed and custom functions for enrichment and research jobs.
api_surface: REST API for running routines and functions.

name: GitHub
one_liner: GitHub provides a REST API to access and manage repositories, issues, pull requests, and other developer resources.
api_surface: Broad REST API for interacting with repositories, users, organizations, and issues.

name: Vercel
one_liner: Vercel provides a REST API and TypeScript SDK to manage deployments, domains, projects, and infrastructure on the Vercel platform.
api_surface: Broad REST API with a companion TypeScript SDK covering dozens of resources including deployments, domains, DNS, and logging drains.

name: Netlify
one_liner: Netlify provides a REST API to manage sites, atomic deploys, form submissions, DNS, and serverless functions.
api_surface: Broad REST API supporting sites, deploys, builds, environment variables, and domains.

name: Cloudflare
one_liner: Cloudflare provides an infrastructure and security platform with a REST API for managing DNS, zones, and web services.
api_surface: Broad REST API supporting version 4 HTTPS endpoints.

name: Supabase
one_liner: Supabase provides a backend-as-a-service platform with a management API and project API keys to programmatically manage databases, authentication, and projects.
api_surface: REST API, broad management and project API surface.

name: Neo4j
one_liner: Neo4j is a graph database platform with a query API for reading and writing graph data.
api_surface: REST API via query and HTTP endpoints for interacting with graph data.

name: Snowflake
one_liner: Snowflake provides a cloud-based data platform with REST APIs and SQL APIs for managing and querying data.
api_surface: REST API and SQL API for accessing data resources and databases.

name: MongoDB Atlas
one_liner: MongoDB Atlas Administration API allows developers to programmatically manage all components and database infrastructure in MongoDB Atlas.
api_surface: Broad REST API supporting OAuth2 service accounts and HTTP digest-based programmatic API keys for managing MongoDB Atlas resources.

name: Datadog
one_liner: Datadog provides cloud-scale monitoring and security via a comprehensive HTTP REST API.
api_surface: Broad HTTP REST API with official client libraries across multiple languages.

name: Sentry
one_liner: Sentry tracks and monitors software errors and application performance.
api_surface: REST API with endpoints for organizations, projects, teams, members, issues, events, and releases.

name: Notion
one_liner: Notion provides an API for interacting with databases, pages, blocks, users, and comments.
api_surface: REST API covering broad resources such as databases, pages, blocks, users, and comments.

name: Airtable
one_liner: Airtable provides a web API to programmatically access, create, update, and manage bases, tables, and records.
api_surface: REST API with broad coverage of records, bases, tables, and metadata.

name: Linear
one_liner: Linear is a project management tool providing a GraphQL API for managing issues, projects, and cycles.
api_surface: Broad GraphQL API covering issues, projects, teams, and comments.

name: Jira
one_liner: Jira provides a comprehensive REST API to interact with Jira programmatically for building apps, scripts, and integrations.
api_surface: Broad REST API (v2 and v3) covering issues, projects, workflows, and administrative settings.

name: Asana
one_liner: Asana's API allows developers to programmatically interact with tasks, projects, and portfolios.
api_surface: REST API with broad coverage of Asana resources.

name: Monday.com
one_liner: Monday.com provides a platform for work management and project tracking.
api_surface: Broad GraphQL API via a single endpoint.

name: ClickUp
one_liner: ClickUp provides a project management tool with a public API to access tasks, spaces, lists, and users.
api_surface: REST API with an OpenAPI specification providing broad access to ClickUp resources.

name: Coda
one_liner: The Coda API enables developers to programmatically read and write data to Coda documents, tables, and columns.
api_surface: Broad REST API supporting documents, tables, columns, rows, and account functions.

name: Smartsheet
one_liner: Smartsheet provides a platform for managing and automating collaborative work, projects, and processes.
api_surface: REST API covering core features like sheets, rows, columns, cells, and automated workflows.

name: Harvest
one_liner: Harvest is a time tracking and project invoicing tool that tracks time spent on projects and generates invoices.
api_surface: REST API with comprehensive coverage of Harvest resources including time tracking, projects, clients, and invoices.

name: Stripe
one_liner: Stripe provides a payment processing and financial infrastructure REST API for online businesses.
api_surface: Broad REST API with extensive resources for charges, customers, subscriptions, and billing.

name: Plaid
one_liner: Plaid provides an API to connect applications with users bank accounts for financial data and payments.
api_surface: Broad REST API over JSON with multiple endpoints and webhooks.

name: Binance
one_liner: Binance provides broad REST and WebSocket APIs for cryptocurrency trading and account management.
api_surface: Broad REST and WebSocket APIs covering spot trading, futures, and market data.
blocker: Binance Login (OAuth2.0) is exclusively offered to close ecosystem partners.

name: Paygent Connect
one_liner: Paygent provides a backend API and SDK for tracking LLM usage, managing spend limits, and enforcing budgets per user or session.
api_surface: REST API with endpoints for products, configuration, users, usage tracking, and batch events.

name: iPayX
one_liner: IXOPAY provides a payment orchestration platform with APIs for processing online payments and managing entities.
api_surface: REST API with multiple resources including transaction, provisioning, and pay-by-link APIs.
blocker: Certain APIs like provisioning require contacting sales or customer success.

name: QuickBooks
one_liner: QuickBooks provides an accounting REST API to manage financial data, invoices, customers, and payments.
api_surface: REST API with broad coverage of accounting and financial data resources.

name: Xero
one_liner: Xero provides accounting and financial management software for small businesses.
api_surface: Broad REST API accessible via OAuth 2.0 with OpenAPI specifications available.

name: Brex
one_liner: Brex provides a REST API to manage corporate cards, cash accounts, vendors, and transfer payments.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering cash accounts, cards, vendors, and transfers.

name: Ramp
one_liner: Ramp provides an API to manage corporate cards, expenses, reimbursements, and accounting automation.
api_surface: Broad REST API supporting cards, transactions, users, and accounting resources.
blocker: Assumes you are a Ramp customer and sandbox access must be requested.

name: PitchBook
one_liner: PitchBook provides private and public market financial data covering the VC, PE, and M&A ecosystem.
api_surface: Model Context Protocol server and enterprise direct data feeds.
blocker: Requires a PitchBook seat-based or trial license and sales outreach.

name: NotebookLM
one_liner: NotebookLM allows users to manage notebooks, add sources, chat with documents, and generate audio or media artifacts using an unofficial client library or CLI.
api_surface: Python library and CLI wrapping unofficial internal endpoints and browser authentication, exposing notebook CRUD, sources, and artifacts.

name: Otter AI
one_liner: Otter.ai's Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details from an Otter account.
api_surface: REST API with endpoints for channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, and webhooks.
blocker: Public API is only available for Enterprise workspaces or via contact.

name: Fathom
one_liner: Fathom provides an API and SDKs for accessing meeting data and video content.
api_surface: REST API and official TypeScript and Python SDKs supporting authentication, meetings, and webhooks.

name: Consensus
one_liner: Search peer-reviewed academic research papers programmatically.
api_surface: REST API with endpoint documentation for quick search and an MCP server.
blocker: API key access requires enterprise sales contact.

name: Reducto
one_liner: Reducto provides an API to parse, extract, split, edit, and classify documents.
api_surface: REST API with SDK support for parsing, extracting, splitting, editing, and classifying documents.

name: Devin
one_liner: Devin provides an AI software engineer platform with an API for managing sessions, playbooks, secrets, and integrations.
api_surface: Broad REST API via OpenAPI/FastAPI.

name: higgsfield
one_liner: Generate images, video, audio, and 3D content through one asynchronous API.
api_surface: REST API with asynchronous request lifecycle for generating media models.

name: Mermaid CLI
one_liner: Core authenticated MERMAID data read/write API for coral reef data collection, management and reporting.
api_surface: REST API with secure endpoints for coral reef data management.
blocker: Credentials must be requested from the MERMAID team.

name: YouTube Transcript
one_liner: Extract transcripts, search videos, and fetch metadata from YouTube programmatically.
api_surface: REST API with endpoints for extracting transcripts, getting video info, searching YouTube and channels, resolving handles, and listing uploads or playlist videos.

name: Grain
one_liner: Grain provides an API to access, manage, and upload video recordings and transcripts from meetings.
api_surface: Broad REST API supporting recordings, transcripts, webhooks, tags, and user/team management.
blocker: Developer access is limited to select partners; outreach to support required.
